nodes.label: ADR-001 Ticket and phone public proposal access
nodes.summary: Accepted MVP decision dated 2026-08-24: resume using ticket number and phone number, then issue scoped access session.
nodes.rationale: Mobile users need to resume long drafts without accounts; ticket alone is insufficient authorization.
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Ticket phone scoped resume session
nodes.summary: Verify ticket plus phone once, issue limited session, store encrypted phone with exact HMAC lookup; private authorized file endpoints.
nodes.rationale: Avoid per-step retransmission and ticket-only cross-proposal access while allowing mobile resume.

nodes.label: Credential and IP access throttling
nodes.summary: Rate-limit credential pairs and IP, return generic errors; phone is a weak secret and future OTP verification boundary stays isolated.
nodes.rationale: Reduce enumeration without imposing account or paid OTP onboarding on MVP.
